fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities cut Dell Technologies (DELL) target price to $341, a 30% reduction, maintaining a 'sell' rating, with stock down 45% year-to-date.
fields.summary_ko.1: Enterprise server shipments are projected to decline 9% in fiscal 2027, and with weak PC shipments compounding headwinds, stock recovery is unlikely despite near-term earnings strength.
fields.summary_ko.2: Dell lost some SpaceX VR200 orders to Hon Hai as AI business competition intensifies, with Q4 projected EPS of $7.18 expected to exceed consensus of $6.50.
